title: Which Avatar element are you? Avatar: The Last Airbender bending quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Avatar: The Last Airbender quiz: answer 12 questions to find whether you would be a Waterbender, Earthbender, Firebender or Airbender, and the benders who share your element. No sign-up.
h1: Which Avatar element would you bend?
lede: Water, Earth, Fire or Air? Answer 12 questions about how you face problems and treat people, and find out which of the four nations you'd belong to in Avatar: The Last Airbender.
about: In Avatar: The Last Airbender, each bending art reflects a way of life: Water is the element of change and community, Earth of strength and endurance, Fire of drive and willpower, and Air of freedom and detachment. This quiz matches your habits to those philosophies.

Your result names your element, famous benders who share it and your scores for all four. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nickelodeon or Paramount; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: What are the four elements in Avatar?
faq.a: Water, Earth, Fire and Air, each tied to one nation: the Water Tribes, the Earth Kingdom, the Fire Nation and the Air Nomads. The Avatar is the only one who can bend all four.
None of them. The show treats them as balanced, each with its own strengths, and the Avatar has to learn all four.
In the show, most people can't bend at all, and Sokka proves you don't need to. This quiz always picks the element that suits you best.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

items.q: Your friends come to you for…
options: A fresh way to look at things
A temple high in the mountains
A village on the ice by the sea
Stand firm and wait for the right moment
Avoid the fight if you can and find another way
Adapt and find a way around it
You hold grudges longer than you admit
Calm on the surface, deep underneath

items.q: A friend lets you down. You…
options: Let it go and move on
Tell them exactly what they did
Blow up, then cool off just as fast
Feel it deeply, then forgive in time
The one who drives everyone forward
Gliding, or anything with a view
The people who depend on you

water.name: Waterbender
water.body: Adaptable, caring and deeper than you look. You go with the flow until something matters, then you are unstoppable, and you'd do anything for your family and community. Fellow Waterbenders: Katara and Korra.

earth.name: Earthbender
earth.body: Grounded, honest and stubborn in the best way. You wait for the right moment, stand your ground and never pretend to be someone you're not. Fellow Earthbenders: Toph Beifong and King Bumi.

fire.name: Firebender
fire.body: Driven, passionate and full of willpower. You chase your goals hard and feel everything intensely, and you've learned that real strength comes from balance. Fellow Firebenders: Zuko and Uncle Iroh.

air.name: Airbender
air.body: Free-spirited, playful and peaceful. You'd rather find another way than fight, you value your freedom and you bring lightness to everyone around you. Fellow Airbenders: Aang and Jinora.
